heading: PLC Splitter
bottomHtml:
PLC Splitter – High-Performance Fiber Optic Splitter for FTTH & PON Networks | D CORE


The PLC Splitter from D CORE is a premium optical splitter designed for FTTH, FTTx, PON, and GPON networks. Using advanced Planar Lightwave Circuit (PLC) technology, it ensures uniform signal distribution, low insertion loss, and high stability across all output ports.

Available in multiple split ratios, including 1x2, 1x4, 1x8, 1x16, 1x32, and 1x64, the PLC Splitter is ideal for long-distance fiber deployments, high-density subscriber networks, and ISP or telecom applications in Bangladesh.

Key Features:


  • Wide wavelength support: 1260–1650 nm (EPON, GPON, CATV compatible)
  • Low insertion loss & high uniformity (≤1.0 dB)
  • Durable packaging: Mini Module, ABS Box, LGX Box, Rack Mount
  • Multiple connector options: SC/UPC, SC/APC, LC/UPC, LC/APC, bare fiber
  • Certified reliability: Telcordia GR-1209 & GR-1221 standards
